'''Serrabloom''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Stalkerix]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Orchitoria]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Every slash lands like a pair of pruning shears trimming flower branches. By the time those blades pull back, the unruly twigs are already gone... Why has nobody filmed the famous Mantis Waltz yet?"

Serrabloom is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A pink, white, and green orchid mantis with large arms and an elegant, light green cape draped behind it.

Serrabloom's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces pink with magenta, and green becomes aquamarine.

== Evolution Trial ==
Serrabloom's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Orchitoria]] you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Shoot 60,000 pinballs.
* Own 24-star Grass Tatari x3.

== Trivia ==
* Old Bio: "And no male Serrablooms have been found in the wild... Wonder what we'd call them?"
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "If female mantises eat before mating, they shouldn't want to eat their mates...right? Do male Serrablooms even exist?"
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "The flower blades on Serrabloom's front legs are razor-sharp. Attacks flow with the elegance of a deadly, silent dance."
